test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Back in April

P. an afternoon walking around

Q. the Tillman Sand Ridge Heritage Preserve

R. I was visiting family in South Carolina

S. and my brother and I spent
solution:
The correct answer is '**RSPQ**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event,
